function.name: plant_biomass

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time air‑quality data. However, you can check the current Air Quality Index (AQI) for Los Angeles on the U.S. EPA’s AirNow website, the City of Los Angeles official portal, or popular weather apps like AccuWeather, Weather Underground, or the AQICN app. These sources update hourly and will give you the latest AQI value, pollutant concentrations, and health recommendations.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "洛杉磯現在的空氣質量如何？" which means "What is the current air quality in Los Angeles?" They want real-time data. We cannot fetch real-time data. According to policy, we should respond with a refusal or safe completion. We can say we don't have real-time data. We can provide general info about typical air quality and how to check. So we refuse to provide real-time data.
